seo.title: Perplexity Buy with Pro: in-chat checkout and merchant program (2024)
seo.meta_description: Since November 2024, Buy with Pro enables one-click purchase inside Perplexity; the platform reports a 5x increase in shopping-intent queries.
seo.resume_citable: In November 2024, Perplexity launched Buy with Pro, a one-click checkout in the assistant backed by Shopify, with a free merchant program where brands keep 100 percent of the revenue; Perplexity reports a 5x increase in shopping-intent queries since launch.

faq.q: How does a brand appear in Perplexity Shopping?
faq.a: Through the free merchant program: the brand shares its product specifications via a single API and becomes eligible for recommendations and Buy with Pro checkout, keeping 100 percent of the revenue.

faq.q: Is Buy with Pro available in Europe?
faq.a: The checkout first launched in the United States for Pro subscribers. Availability of the channel outside the US remains to be verified as of this record's date.

pattern: agentic commerce (product recommendation and in-chat checkout)
objectif_business: Open a channel where the user moves from product search to purchase without leaving the assistant, and give brands a way to be recommended and sold directly in the answers.
description: In November 2024, Perplexity launched Buy with Pro, a one-click checkout reserved at first for its Pro subscribers in the United States. The user receives product recommendations in the answers and can order without going to the merchant's site: address and card stored in Perplexity, tax calculation, free shipping on Buy with Pro orders. The discovery experience relies on a Shopify integration to access the products of merchants that sell and ship to the United States. In parallel, Perplexity opened a free merchant program: brands share their product specifications via a single API, keep 100 percent of the sales revenue, and gain visibility in the recommendations. Perplexity reported a 5x increase in shopping-intent queries since launch.

resultats.metrique: Shopping-intent queries since the launch of Buy with Pro
Revenue kept by the merchant (free program)

niveau_preuve.justification: Launch covered by name by the established press (TechCrunch), cross-checked by Perplexity's official blog and the e-commerce trade press. The 5x figure is a platform statement, hence a C level rather than B.

stack_technique.detail: LLM answer engine that indexes products and recommends them in answers with purchase intent, with the in-app Buy with Pro checkout. Underlying models not detailed for shopping.
Free program: the brand shares its product specifications via a single API, keeps 100 percent of the revenue, and gains visibility in the recommendations.
Integration used for the discovery of products from Shopify merchants that sell and ship to the United States.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on the user side; on the brand side, the product feed is synchronized continuously via the merchant API.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: On the brand side: the e-commerce / product-feed team that feeds and maintains the specifications. On the channel side: Perplexity operates the engine and the checkout.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The quality and freshness of the product feed (specifications, price, availability). If the feed is poor or stale, the brand is recommended less often and the checkout fails.

etapes.detail: The brand shares its product specifications via Perplexity's single API, for free.
Perplexity indexes the products and offers them in answers with purchase intent.
The user orders in one click inside Perplexity; the order is passed to the merchant, who keeps 100 percent of the revenue.
The brand handles the order and ships it through its existing logistics operation.

playbook.action: Check eligibility (selling and shipping to the United States) and audit the quality of the product feed: specifications, price, availability.
Enroll in the free merchant program and connect the catalog via Perplexity's product API.
playbook.livrable: Catalog exposed in the shopping index

playbook.action: Test targeted purchase queries on the category and note the presence of the products in the recommendations.
playbook.livrable: Visibility record in the shopping answers

playbook.action: Connect measurement of orders coming from the channel and decide on the level of investment (feed enrichment, catalog coverage).
playbook.livrable: Orders and average-basket read by channel

replication.equipe: 1 e-commerce/feed lead; existing logistics handles the passed orders
prerequis_orga: e-commerce/feed team that maintains the catalog
decision on the margin shared via this channel
replication.premiere_etape: Check eligibility (US shipping) and the quality of the product feed, then enroll in the free merchant program to test visibility.

statut_vivant.note: The program expanded in 2025 (PayPal payment partnership to open the checkout beyond Pro subscribers, growth in the number of merchants). A young and moving channel, but active and expanding.

transposable_ue.note: Buy with Pro launched in the United States. For an EU deployment, the question is not GDPR on the brand side but channel availability: Perplexity's in-chat checkout and merchant program are not open everywhere. An EU brand can already optimize its product presence to be recommended, but in-app payment remains US as of the verification date.
